description: This file defines the Vtiger_Profile class, which provides an API for managing profiles within the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for initializing and deleting profile settings related to fields and modules, as well as logging and retrieving profile IDs.

classes.name: Vtiger_Profile
classes.description: Class providing API solutions for manipulating CRM profiles, including setup and deletion for fields and modules, along with utility functions.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message using Vtiger_Utils, optionally with a linebreak.

methods.name: initForField
methods.description: Initializes profile setup for a specific field by inserting visibility and read-only permissions into related database tables.

methods.name: deleteForField
methods.description: Removes profile-related records for a specific field from relevant database tables.

methods.name: getAllIds
methods.description: Retrieves all existing profile IDs from the database.

methods.name: initForModule
methods.description: Initializes profile permissions for a specified module, including standard actions like Save, Edit, Delete, etc.

methods.name: deleteForModule
methods.description: Removes all profile permissions associated with a specific module.
